mods.name: cmd-mod-hi
mods.description: Roasts you every time you greet your agent with "hi". One transformInput hook plus a renderer, and a /hi-stats command that tallies the damage.

mods.name: cmd-mod-review
mods.description: Evidence-based /review-changes for bugs, regressions, and test gaps. Included in the community bundle; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-standup
mods.description: Draft /standup updates from recent commits and working changes. Included in the community bundle; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-pr-draft
mods.description: Draft a PR title and body with /pr-draft using actual Git changes. Included in the community bundle; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-release-notes
mods.description: Write /release-notes from a base ref, separating uncommitted work. Included in the community bundle; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-test-plan
mods.description: Build a concrete regression /test-plan from changed code. Included in the community bundle; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-git-summary
mods.description: Show /git-summary without spending a model call. Included in the community bundle; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-context-meter
mods.description: Show measured context use in the footer and with /context-meter. Included in the community bundle; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-run-stats
mods.description: Track elapsed time and completed/failed tools with /run-stats. Included in the community bundle; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-bookmarks
mods.description: Save and return to labelled session points with /bookmark and /jump-bookmark. Included in the community bundle; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-focus
mods.description: Keep work scoped with /focus, a session-persistent prompt reminder. Included in the community bundle; installing adds all 10 mods.
